parts.name: Lamp Body
parts.Basic_description: The lamp body is the main supporting structure of the lamp, typically made of wood. It provides stability and houses the electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lamp unit and contains the wiring and switch mechanism. It also serves as the base that keeps the lamp upright.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Lamp Unit
parts.Basic_description: The lamp unit consists of the lampshade and bulb housing, typically made of fabric or paper for light diffusion.
parts.Functional_description: It diffuses and softens the light emitted by the bulb, providing ambient illumination and reducing glare.
parts.Movement_description: It is usually fixed but can be removed or adjusted for bulb replacement or cleaning.
